name: Slack Connector
description: Read and operate on Slack workspaces: list channels, read channel history and threads, search messages, look up users, post and reply to messages, react, pin and manage channels across multiple workspaces.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the connected Slack workspaces and whether each token still works.

refresh.description: Re-read workspace details from Slack instead of the cache
refresh.title: Refresh

return_schema.description: One connected Slack workspace and whether its token still works.
return_schema.title: WorkspaceRecord

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List Slack channels and conversations the app can see, with topics and whether the app is a member.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

query.description: Filter channels by name fragment, e.g. 'standup'. Empty returns all visible channels.
query.title: Query

kind.description: Limit to 'public', 'private', 'dm' or 'group_dm'. Empty returns every kind the app can see.
kind.title: Kind

member_only.description: Only channels the app itself belongs to
member_only.title: Member Only

return_schema.description: A conversation: channel, private channel, DM or group DM.
return_schema.title: ChannelRecord

tools.name: read_channel
tools.description: Read recent messages in a Slack channel by name -- actual text, with mentions and links resolved.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

channel.description: Channel name or id, e.g. '#general', 'general' or 'C024BE7LR'
channel.title: Channel

limit.description: How many recent messages to read (newest first)
limit.title: Limit

include_thread_counts.description: Report how many replies each message has
include_thread_counts.title: Include Thread Counts

return_schema.description: One message, with mentions and links already rendered readable.
return_schema.title: MessageRecord

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a Slack thread: the parent message and all its replies in order.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

channel.description: Channel name or id the thread lives in
channel.title: Channel

ts.description: Timestamp of the thread's parent message, e.g. '1690000000.123456'. Pass it as text, not a number.
ts.title: Ts

return_schema.description: One message, with mentions and links already rendered readable.
return_schema.title: MessageRecord

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search Slack messages across the workspace. Needs a user token -- Slack does not offer search to bot tokens.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

query.description: Search text. Slack modifiers work too, e.g. 'in:#general from:@vlad deploy'.
query.title: Query

return_schema.description: A search match -- carries its channel, since results span the workspace.
return_schema.title: SearchHit

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List people in the Slack workspace, with names, emails and titles.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

query.description: Filter by name or email fragment. Empty lists everyone.
query.title: Query

include_bots.description: Include bot and app users (excluded by default)
include_bots.title: Include Bots

tools.name: check_access
tools.description: Report what this Slack app can currently reach, and explain why anything missing is not visible.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

return_schema.description: What the token can currently reach, and why anything missing is missing.
return_schema.title: AccessReport

tools.name: connect_workspace
tools.description: Connect a Slack workspace by saving its token, after checking the token actually works.

params_schema.description:
The token the user pastes on the Connect screen.

Not WorkspaceScoped: this is the one action that runs BEFORE any workspace
exists, so asking which workspace to act in would be circular. The
workspace is discovered FROM the token.

token.description: Slack app token: bot token starts with 'xoxb-', user token with 'xoxp-'. Create one at api.slack.com/apps.
token.title: Token

params_schema.title: ConnectWorkspaceParams

return_schema.description: Reuses the ack shape; `name` carries the workspace name.
return_schema.title: _ConnectAck

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a Slack message to a channel or person, or reply inside a thread.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

channel.description: Channel name or id to post to, e.g. '#general'. A person's name or @handle sends a direct message.
channel.title: Channel

thread_ts.description: Reply inside an existing thread instead of posting to the channel. Timestamp of the parent message, as text.
thread_ts.title: Thread Ts

reply_broadcast.description: When replying in a thread, also show the reply in the channel
reply_broadcast.title: Reply Broadcast

return_schema.description: Confirmation of a write against a message.
return_schema.title: MessageAck

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit the text of a Slack message the app posted.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

channel.description: Channel name or id the message is in
channel.title: Channel

ts.description: Timestamp of the message to edit, as text
ts.title: Ts

return_schema.description: Confirmation of a write against a message.
return_schema.title: MessageAck

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a Slack message the app posted.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

channel.description: Channel name or id the message is in
channel.title: Channel

ts.description: Timestamp of the message to delete, as text
ts.title: Ts

return_schema.description: Confirmation of a write against a message.
return_schema.title: MessageAck

tools.name: react_to_message
tools.description: Add or remove an emoji reaction on a Slack message.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

channel.description: Channel name or id the message is in
channel.title: Channel

ts.description: Timestamp of the message to react to, as text
ts.title: Ts

emoji.description: Emoji name without colons, e.g. 'thumbsup' or 'eyes'
emoji.title: Emoji

remove.description: Set true to remove the reaction instead of adding it
remove.title: Remove

return_schema.description: Confirmation of a write against a message.
return_schema.title: MessageAck

tools.name: pin_message
tools.description: Pin or unpin a Slack message in its channel.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

channel.description: Channel name or id the message is in
channel.title: Channel

ts.description: Timestamp of the message to pin, as text
ts.title: Ts

unpin.description: Set true to unpin instead of pin
unpin.title: Unpin

return_schema.description: Confirmation of a write against a message.
return_schema.title: MessageAck

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a Slack channel, optionally private, with a topic and invitees.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

name.description: Channel name, e.g. 'project-apollo'. Slack lowercases it and replaces spaces with hyphens.
name.title: Name

private.description: Create a private channel instead of a public one
private.title: Private

invite.description: Optional comma-separated names to invite, e.g. '@vlad, @maria'
invite.title: Invite

return_schema.description: Confirmation of a write against a channel.
return_schema.title: ChannelAck

tools.name: invite_to_channel
tools.description: Invite people to a Slack channel by name.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

channel.description: Channel name or id to invite into
channel.title: Channel

users.description: Comma-separated names, @handles or ids to invite
users.title: Users

return_schema.description: Confirmation of a write against a channel.
return_schema.title: ChannelAck

tools.name: set_channel_topic
tools.description: Set a Slack channel's topic and/or purpose.

workspace.description: Workspace name, e.g. 'Acme'. Omit when only one Slack workspace is connected.
workspace.title: Workspace

channel.description: Channel name or id to update
channel.title: Channel

topic.description: New channel topic. Empty clears it.
topic.title: Topic

purpose.description: New channel purpose/description. Empty leaves it as is.
purpose.title: Purpose

return_schema.description: Confirmation of a write against a channel.
return_schema.title: ChannelAck

secrets.name: slack_tokens
secrets.description: Slack app token(s) -- one per line, one line per workspace. Create an app at api.slack.com/apps, add the scopes you need, install it to the workspace, then copy the Bot User OAuth Token (starts with xoxb-).
